findings.title: The title says seven cards closed while the article reports eight
findings.location: The title on line 3 says seven; lines 6 and 11 say eight and lines 15 through 61 enumerate eight PRs.
findings.explanation: The shipment list contains eight distinct merged BookcaseDiscovery PRs: #60, #58 and #61 through #66. The title disagrees with the article's own correct summary and list.
findings.correction: Change the title count from seven to eight.

findings.title: PRs 59 and 53 are not the nearest independent merge candidates
findings.location: Lines 105, 107, 121, 124 and 125 call #59 and #53 nearest merge candidates and say no technical dependency remains.
findings.explanation: PR #59 is stacked on #53; #53 is stacked on #40 and marked draft/do not merge; #40 depends on core #584. The article erases explicit technical ordering constraints.
findings.correction: Report the recorded order as core #584 to BookcaseDiscovery #40 to #53 to #59, with each PR's existing draft, review and owner gates; do not present #59 or #53 as independently ready.

findings.title: Core 584 is not a recorded prerequisite for BookcaseDiscovery 30
findings.location: Lines 105 and 107 say #30 is blocked on all of core #579 through #584.
findings.explanation: Core issue #578's completed happy-path checklist includes #579, #580, #581, BookcaseDiscovery #30, #582 and #583, but not #584. BookcaseDiscovery #30 records dependencies on the #578 path and #580/#581; #584 is later resident-worker follow-up work.
findings.correction: Describe #30 against its recorded core #578/#580/#581 prerequisites and current PR state; treat #584 as follow-up work unless the owning PR records that dependency.

findings.title: The held dataset command uses unsupported CLI flags
findings.location: Line 121 proposes bookcase dataset build --dry-run --box-set pre-rb1.
findings.explanation: The shipped dataset CLI accepts --set, --version and --help. It does not define --dry-run or --box-set, and the build command writes a new private dataset version.
findings.correction: Do not execute the proposed command. Use a documented read-only verification path, or add an explicitly reviewed non-writing mode first.
